parameters.name: CasId
parameters.description: The cloud certificate ID. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description: The certificate content. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The certificate ID. Free certificates created by calling the ApplyCertificate operation are not supported. Certificate IDs of the cas and upload types are supported.

parameters.name: KeyServerId
parameters.description: The keyless server ID. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to keyless.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The certificate name. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas. Valid values:

- Alibaba Cloud China Website accounts: cn-hangzhou.

- Alibaba Cloud International Website accounts: ap-southeast-1.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The certificate type. Valid values:

- **cas**: a certificate from SSL Certificates Service.

- **upload**: a custom uploaded certificate.

- **keyless**: a keyless certificate.
